import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_0.csv",

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_3.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes
dfs = []

# Load each source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # The source schema is ['State Name', 'AQI', 'Year', 'Month'] which matches target schema exactly
    # So no column renaming or reordering needed
    # Just ensure correct dtypes as per target schema:
    # 'State Name': string, 'Year': int, 'Month': int, 'AQI': int

    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    df['Month'] = df['Month'].astype(int)
    df['AQI'] = df['AQI'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target,
# we can concatenate (union) all source dataframes vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target examples have 2273 rows, but source tables have 20000 rows each,
# so the target is likely a filtered subset or aggregated version.
# However, no aggregation or filtering instructions are given,
# so we output the full union as the target.

# Save the combined dataframe to the target CSV file path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_0.csv', index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_1.csv', index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_2.csv', index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/training_3.csv', index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY 'State Name', 'Year', 'Month' and aggregate AQI by mean, then round and convert to int
df_grouped = df_union.groupby(['State Name', 'Year', 'Month'], as_index=False).agg({'AQI': 'mean'})

# Round AQI to nearest integer and convert to int type
df_grouped['AQI'] = df_grouped['AQI'].round().astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_grouped = df_grouped[['State Name', 'Year', 'Month', 'AQI']]

# Write output to target file
df_grouped.to_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_20/target_multisource_critique_history.csv', index=False)
